meta.name: dmux-workflows
meta.description: Multi-agent orchestration using dmux (tmux pane manager for AI agents). Patterns for parallel agent workflows across Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and other harnesses. Use when running multiple agent sessions in parallel or coordinating multi-agent development workflows.

copy.tagline: 并行运行多个AI agent会话并协调工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个AI agent间协调并行开发任务
copy.tagline_en: Run multiple AI agent sessions in parallel and coordinate workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to coordinate parallel development tasks across multiple AI agents

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以协调多个 AI 代理并行工作，例如同时进行代码编写、测试和文档更新，并通过 dmux 工具管理这些代理会话。
howto.when: 当用户需要并行运行多个代理会话，或要求“并行运行”、“拆分工作”、“使用 dmux”、“多代理”时触发。

say.text: 用 dmux 并行实现认证中间件和编写测试。
say.note: Claude 会创建两个代理会话分别处理。

say.text: 并行研究 Node.js 限流最佳实践并实现中间件。
say.note: 一个代理研究，另一个实现，最后合并结果。

say.text: 用 dmux 同时审查 API 的安全性和性能。
say.note: 两个代理分别审查不同方面。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can orchestrate multiple AI agent sessions in parallel, such as coding, testing, and documentation, using dmux for pane management.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to run multiple agent sessions in parallel, or says 'run in parallel', 'split this work', 'use dmux', or 'multi-agent'.

say_en.text: Use dmux to implement auth middleware and write tests in parallel.
say_en.note: Claude creates two agent sessions for each task.

say_en.text: Research rate limiting best practices and implement middleware in parallel.
say_en.note: One agent researches, another implements, then merges.

say_en.text: Use dmux to review API security and performance simultaneously.
